messages:
maya: Heads up — eval CI flagged a quality regression on quantized-1.2 when running the summarization suite. delta +4.2 BLEU vs baseline. eval-bot attached the report. :warning:

eval-bot: Automated alert: regression detected for model=quantized-1.2, suite=summarization-regress-2026, metric=BLEU, delta=+4.2. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/9876 (uploaded)

aj: Copying in — I started a quick bisect across the last two releases. Preliminary: runner v2.5.3 reproduces, v2.5.2 does not. Suspect change in decode/token handling in the runner.

liam: Can you paste the failing assertion / test name?

aj: Sure — local failing test snippet:
```
FAIL tests/suites/summarization/rouge_suite.py::test_rouge_consistency
AssertionError: rouge-l expected >= 0.32 got 0.27
Command: python -m eval_runner --suite summarization-regress-2026 --model quantized-1.2 --seed 42
```

sophie: Hmm that error smells like whitespace/tokenization differences rather than model semantics. We had a small change to postprocess whitespace trimming in the runner patch earlier this week.

kevin: We didn't bump tokenizers in the env (still pinned to 0.10.x), so it's likely a runner-level change. Looking at the diff, commit 2026-10-02T11:22: added aggressive "collapse_whitespace=True" in decode path.

aj: Confirmed: toggling collapse_whitespace back to False in my local checkout makes the test pass. Bisect trace: 2026-10-02T11:22 -> introduced regression.

maya: Customer-facing deploy scheduled in ~6h. Options: 1) rollback runner to v2.5.2, 2) hotfix to revert whitespace change, 3) add metric tolerancing to avoid alert spam and delay decision. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

liam: Hotfix is my vote — revert the single-line change in runner and add an explicit decode unit test to prevent regressions. Rollback is heavier for infra.

aj: I opened PR #3421 that reverts the whitespace collapse and adds a determinism test (seeded). Local unit + small eval suite passed. Pushing to CI: https://git.internal/pulls/3421

eval-bot: CI job started for PR #3421 — full eval suite queued (job 9890). Estimated runtime 25m.

kevin: Also proposing a small tweak to eval harness: add a per-metric tolerancing config (e.g., allowed_delta_percent) and a flag to suppress regressions on quantized variants by default. That would prevent noisy tickets for known distribution shifts. I'll file a follow-up RFC.

sophie: Please also log raw token sequences to artifact storage for failing runs (helps triage whitespace/emoji edge cases).

aj: CI for PR #3421 came back green for unit tests and the reduced eval suite. Kicking the full suite now.

maya: Plan: if full eval suite remains green within 2h, merge PR and release hotfix to staging, run mirror-prod regressions, then promote. If not green, rollback to runner v2.5.2 on prod. I'll notify support and legal for the potential customer impact.

liam: Adding a quick checklist in the PR: revert commit id, add unit test, add changelog note, add integration smoke.

kevin: I'll prep the tolerancing RFC and a short change in eval CI to surface tolerances in the report UI.

maya: Thanks everyone. Tagging @support to prep customer comms (maya -> @support). :thumbsup:

aj: Follow-up: created issue #578: "eval-harness: metric tolerancing + token artifact logging" and linked to PR #3421.

eval-bot: Full eval suite finished — result: PASS for PR #3421, all metrics within expected ranges. Closing regression alert.

maya: Merged and promoted hotfix to staging; running prod mirror now. Will update again after mirror completes.

kevin: After-action items: add tolerancing flag, add token artifacts, add decode unit test to golden set.

maya: Closing thread for now; reopening if we see post-release anomalies. Thanks team. :rocket:
